description: Semantic contradiction detection framework. Update when threat actor behavior patterns change.

contradiction_classes.name: APT_SECTOR_MISMATCH
contradiction_classes.description: The attributed threat group has no known history targeting this sector
contradiction_classes.mitigates: Validates APT-sector pairings against known campaigns
contradiction_classes.external_source: MITRE ATT&CK, threat reports, historical analyst assessments

contradiction_classes.name: TTP_MALWARE_MISMATCH
contradiction_classes.description: The listed TTPs are inconsistent with the malware family's known behavior
contradiction_classes.mitigates: Validates TTP-malware associations via MITRE ATT&CK

contradiction_classes.name: TTP_SECTOR_MISMATCH
contradiction_classes.description: The listed TTPs do not align with attacks on this type of sector
contradiction_classes.mitigates: Checks if TTPs are sector-appropriate (e.g., ICS exploits for industrial, not finance)

contradiction_classes.name: SEVERITY_CONTEXT_MISMATCH
contradiction_classes.description: The claimed severity is implausible given the malware family and sector
contradiction_classes.mitigates: Detects inflated severity claims (e.g., script kiddie malware marked CRITICAL)

contradiction_classes.name: MALWARE_APT_MISMATCH
contradiction_classes.description: This malware family is not associated with this APT group
contradiction_classes.mitigates: Prevents fake attribution to known APTs
contradiction_classes.external_source: MITRE ATT&CK, threat reports, malware analysis

contradiction_classes.name: IMPLAUSIBLE_COMBINATION
contradiction_classes.description: The overall combination of APT + malware + sector + TTPs has never been observed in real threat intelligence
contradiction_classes.mitigates: Detects fabricated campaigns with impossible patterns

contradiction_classes.name: FEED_CREDIBILITY_CONCERN
contradiction_classes.description: Based on the feed description, single-source high-severity claims are a known injection vector
contradiction_classes.mitigates: Flags non-corroborated high-severity claims from unreliable feeds
contradiction_classes.external_source: Feed reputation tracking, historical poisoning patterns

contradiction_classes.name: INFRASTRUCTURE_IMPLAUSIBLE
contradiction_classes.description: The infrastructure age contradicts the claimed sophistication of the attributed actor
contradiction_classes.mitigates: Detects APT attribution to recently-registered infrastructure
contradiction_classes.external_source: WHOIS data, infrastructure age analysis, APT maturity profiles

notes: C2 is the ONLY contradiction class with automatic validation (MITRE ATT&CK).
C1, C3-C8 rely on LLM semantic reasoning (no external validation).
Update this file when threat actor behavior patterns shift (e.g., new APT debuts, malware evolution).
Version this file in git to track evolution of contradiction definitions.
